prompt:
You are the senior architectural photographer for IWAN Engineering & Consulting in Oran, Algeria.
Create a believable REAL editorial architecture photograph, never a CGI render.
Use sophisticated contemporary Mediterranean / North-African architecture, credible Oran climate,
realistic materials, construction details, tactile micro-textures, natural imperfections, realistic
light and shadows, strong foreground/midground/background depth, deliberate camera position,
corrected verticals and a professional full-frame photographic look. Make the composition interesting:
show a material junction, threshold, courtyard, controlled sunlight, interior/exterior relationship,
construction detail or another meaningful architectural idea instead of a generic centered facade.
The result must look publishable by a serious architecture magazine and by a premium architecture
studio from Algeria/Morocco/Tunisia, without copying any project.
STRICTLY AVOID: generic luxury villa, Dubai mansion, Pinterest look, stock photo, CGI, 3D render,
Unreal Engine, plastic materials, excessive HDR, impossible geometry, distorted windows, fake people,
Arabic decorative clichés, fake text, logo, watermark.

ABSOLUTE TEXT BAN IN GENERATED PIXELS:
Do not render ANY Arabic text, French text, Latin letters, numbers, signs, posters, captions, logos,
watermarks, readable labels, license plates or typography. The generated image must contain only the
photographic scene. IWAN branding is added afterward by software.

PHOTOGRAPHIC ROLE: hero exterior editorial architecture photograph

PROJECT BRIEF:
Sujet éditorial : Astuce confort : Éviter l'effet serre des grandes baies vitrées. Vue extérieure architecturale prise depuis le niveau du regard, composition photographique asymétrique et élégante. Montrer une vraie décision architecturale : profondeur d'entrée, cadrage d'une baie, ombre d'un auvent, relation terrasse-jardin. Architecture contemporaine méditerranéenne crédible à Oran, pierre/travertin/enduit minéral/bois/aluminium selon cohérence. Lumière naturelle de fin d'après-midi, ciel légèrement imparfait, végétation méditerranéenne réaliste, une présence humaine très discrète pour l'échelle. Beaucoup de micro-détails et de profondeur, aucun décor artificiel.

IWAN VISUAL ART DIRECTION:
# IWAN — Master prompt for visual direction and image generation

## Role
Act as a senior art director and architectural visualisation specialist for IWAN Engineering & Consulting in Oran, Algeria.

## Fixed brand reference
- Official logo: https://iwan-architecte-oran.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/logo-iwan-engineering-consulting-architecte-oran.png
- Palette: #0D2C52, #081A33, #F4F1EA, #A9823C, #C9A868.
- Typography direction: Manrope and Fraunces.
- Visual tone: restrained premium editorial design, architectural precision, authentic local context.
- Never generate a substitute logo. Add the original logo only during deterministic post-processing from the official source or a verified stored copy.

## Visual brief
Derive the image from the actual post topic and objective. Specify subject, architecture/construction type, illustrative-vs-real status, locally plausible context, camera angle, composition, lighting, material detail, aspect ratio, safe areas and exclusions.

## Photorealism and authenticity
For villa concepts, use believable contemporary Algerian/Mediterranean residential architecture, plausible structural logic, realistic facade openings, consistent window alignment, credible materials, boundary walls and landscaping, natural sun and shadows.
For construction sites, show plausible work stages, realistic equipment, appropriate PPE and credible organization. Do not create fake evidence of an IWAN-supervised site.
For technical education, prefer a clear detail photograph or restrained diagram rather than misleading photorealistic construction details.
Avoid impossible structural elements, distorted geometry, unsafe PPE, fake company signage, fabricated stamps, watermarks, fake text, generic stock-photo clichés and excessive HDR.
Never label AI-generated imagery as a real client project, real IWAN worksite, completed villa or documentary photograph. Store an internal authenticity note when imagery is illustrative.
Do not ask the image model to render the IWAN logo or long copy. Generate a clean image; place the original logo and approved copy only in post-processing.

QUALITY CHECK: prioritize architectural plausibility, material realism, physical lighting, camera perspective, meaningful secondary details and editorial composition.
